backend/main.mo: Defines a backend actor with comprehensive domain types for patients, lab results, medications, ADRs, narrations, external resources, and drug interactions.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking a specific drug‑pair display requirement to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing responsibilities and optimizations for various frontend files across the app.
frontend/.env.local: Local development environment variables for canister IDs, host URLs, and dev server config.
frontend/index.html: HTML entrypoint that sets up the root element and loads the main React script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling authentication flow, profile loading, dashboard rendering logic, and global providers.
frontend/src/backend.idl.ts: IDL definitions mirroring backend types and services for generating typed frontend actors.
frontend/src/components/AddPatientDialog: React dialog component for adding patients with validation, memoized BMI calculation, and optimized form rendering.
frontend/src/components/AdrForm.tsx: Form component for submitting a new adverse drug reaction tied to a patient, including MedDRA‑based fields and mutation handling.
frontend/src/components/AdrsModule.tsx: Displays patient info and a tabbed interface for recording and viewing ADRs filtered for a specific patient.
frontend/src/components/CaseEntry.tsx: Main case‑entry interface providing tabs for labs, medications, ADRs, and case summary for a selected patient.
frontend/src/components/CaseSummary.tsx: Generates a consolidated summary of patient info, labs, medications, and ADRs with an option to export as PDF.
frontend/src/components/DisclaimersSecti: Renders a styled list of static application disclaimers with contextual icons.
frontend/src/components/DrugDetailsModal: Modal displaying detailed drug information, regulatory status, source, and description, with special handling for new or banned drugs.
frontend/src/components/DrugDrugInteract: Provides a searchable drug interaction database UI with drug details, interaction severity display, and refresh support.
frontend/src/components/DrugInteractions: Allows users to enter up to four drugs, validates inputs, and checks multi-drug interactions with severity and risk summaries.
Displays sortable and filterable drug tables with status tabs, search, category filtering, sync status, and detailed drug modals.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with branding, logo, and usage disclaimer.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Shows the application header with branding, user greeting, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/LabResultsForm.t: Form for entering lab values, validating ranges, and submitting results for a patient.
frontend/src/components/LabResultsModule: Loads patient data and lab history, offering tabs for entering new lab results or viewing past results.
frontend/src/components/LoginScreen.tsx: Renders a login screen with Internet Identity authentication, logo preloading, and error-handling UI.
frontend/src/components/MedicationForm.t: Form component for adding patient medications with validation and mutation submission.
frontend/src/components/MedicationsModul: Displays patient info and medication tabs, allowing entry of new medications and viewing history.
frontend/src/components/MonthlyBanTrends: Computes yearly drug ban statistics and displays them in a dialog with summary cards and a chart.
frontend/src/components/MukabotWidget.ts: Empty component file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/PatientDetailsDi: Dialog showing detailed patient info including labs, medications, and ADRs using memoized card components.
frontend/src/components/PatientManagemen: Management interface listing all patients with actions to view details, select, add, or delete entries.
frontend/src/components/PreclinicalDataF: Empty component file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/PreclinicalDataM: Empty component file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/PrescriptionUplo: Empty component file with no implemented content.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal form that collects name and email and submits a profile using useSaveCallerUserProfile, wrapped in a styled gradient UI.
frontend/src/components/RestrictedDrugsM: Displays searchable restricted‑drug categories with detailed drug data and external resources using collapsible sections.
frontend/src/components/WavebotWidget.ts: Floating chat-style widget that manages local messages, patient and lab data, and provides external resource metadata.
frontend/src/data/drugInteractionExample: Defines preset drug‑interaction example sets and provides helpers for loading and validating them.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages an authenticated or anonymous backend actor and refreshes dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Internet Identity provider and hook managing authentication state, login flow, stored identities, and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Custom React Query hooks for fetching and saving user profiles with timeout handling and actor integration.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining theme variables, dark mode styles, and optimized GPU-accelerated utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry point that initializes React, React Query, Internet Identity provider, and global styles.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Dashboard page assembling multiple medical modules with lazy loading, tab management, and intelligent prefetching.
frontend/src/services/cdscoDrugService.t: Client-side service simulating CDSCO drug data fetching with caching and predefined banned drug entries.
frontend/src/services/drugDrugInteractio: Local drug interaction database service providing cached data, defaults, and detailed interaction information.
frontend/src/services/drugInteractionVer: Service that loads, caches, and daily-syncs drug‑interaction data from MIMS India and Toaz Info, using localStorage and scheduled 2 AM IST updates.
frontend/src/services/multiSourceDrugSer: Service managing multi‑source drug data with caching, background sync, incremental updates, and daily 2 AM IST refresh across multiple databases.
frontend/src/utils/drugPairs.ts: Utility functions for normalizing drug names, generating consistent pair keys, comparing pairs, and producing all unique drug pairs.
frontend/src/utils/interactionSummary.ts: Generates an overall interaction summary from pairwise data, ranks severity, extracts key recommendations, and formats severity and toxicity labels.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining theme extensions, colors, typography, animations, and content paths with plugin integration.
project_state.json: Project state file describing app goals, known issues, architecture notes, and required features for drug‑interaction workflow improvements.
